suggestion.title: Rewrite description and battle line
suggestion.rationale: The old text did not match what the jutsu does. The new text describes its damage and its healing boost.

data.description: Within the user's domain, water answers to them alone. It rises to crush their foe, then flows back to its master, deepening their healing for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user spreads their domain across the field, hurling its tide at %target before the waters pool back around %user to strengthen their healing.

suggestion.rationale: The old battle line said Water's Domain saps the target's strength, but it has no such effect, and neither text mentioned what its second effect really does: it makes the caster's own healing 25% stronger for two rounds. The new text ties both effects to the name: the user's domain of water crushes one foe, then flows back to strengthen the user's healing.
